jobs.description:
We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Company located in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?

• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment

• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
• A forklift certificate is a plus
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

package frozen food products for leading food companies according to the highest quality and food safety standards. To support our growth, we are looking for an experienced Packaging Operator to work in a fixed shift.

Jobomschrijving

Your Responsibilities

• Set up and start production orders according to planning and instructions.
• Operate and monitor automated packaging lines and equipment.
• Perform quality checks on products, packaging, labels, and weights.
• Detect minor machine issues and report technical problems when needed.
• Ensure cleanliness, safety, and smooth operation of the production line.
• Work closely with colleagues, team leaders, and the maintenance team.

• Experience as an operator in a production or packaging environment.
• Technical mindset and interest in automated machinery.
• Strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Basic computer skills.
• Willingness to work in a chilled environment (8°C - 10°C).
• Good knowledge of English or French.

Are you detail-oriented, reliable, and looking for a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you!

 

We’re looking for enthusiastic employees to do the packaging of a wide variety of machine parts in Lokeren. As a Packaging Employee, you'll make sure our products are packed with care and precision, ready to be delivered to customers worldwide. For this job, you will use a scanning system and a computer to ensure everything is registered correctly.

Who are we looking for?

• Comfortable standing for long periods without discomfort.

• Available for long-term work, full-time from monday to friday.

• Lifting weights up to 10 kg is not a problem (no physical issues).

• Able to communicate in English and/or Dutch

• Experience as a packaging employee is a plus.

- You enjoy combining physical work with administrative tasks and can easily switch between the two.

Do you like working accurately and enjoy a practical job? For the same family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing. 
- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications. 
- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form.

- You speak and understand English.

- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a Warehouse Operator for a company in Lokeren. 
You will be responsible for checking, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work daytime hours in a technical working environment with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 
- Check technical drawings and verify that all parts are complete. 
- Carry out small tasks such as removing rust and touch-up painting. 
- Prepare parts for shipment. 
- Process and register parts using the internal computer system.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking. 
- You work accurately and in a structured way, with an eye for detail. 
- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems. 
- You are a hands-on team player and speak Dutch or English

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

Jobomschrijving

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.
• Deliver presentations and participate in customer meetings to promote the company's products and services.
• Represent the company at selected industry events, conferences and trade shows to expand network opportunities and generate leads.
• Contribute to the growth of the business by developing new accounts and nurturing long-term customer relationships.

• BS degree in biology or life sciences related fields, or equivalent level of experience.
• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.
• In-depth understanding and track record of best-in-class customer services.
• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.
• Teamwork and customer relationships development capabilities.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events.
• A second European language is a plus.

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

Jobomschrijving

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

Description

Process and monitor domestic and international payment transactions.

Manage client and internal stakeholder queries via email and telephone.

Support cash management and banking operations activities.

Handle trade finance documentation and transaction follow-up.

Maintain banking records, account administration, and compliance-related updates.

Contribute to operational controls, reconciliations, and process improvement initiatives.

As a Junior Market Finance in Brussels, you will contribute to finance activities within the Financial Services industry and help maintain clear financial information for the business. This permanent role offers a solid basis for building practical experience in Banking & Financial Services.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Financial Services industry in Brussels.

Description

As a Junior Market Finance your responsibilities are:

• Contribute to daily finance activities linked to market finance operations.
• Prepare and maintain financial data to support accurate reporting.
• Review financial information and help identify inconsistencies for follow-up.
• Support the preparation of regular finance reports for internal stakeholders.
• Organise relevant financial documentation to keep information clear and accessible.
• Work with colleagues in Banking & Financial Services to share reliable financial data.
• Help improve the quality and consistency of finance-related information.

A successful Junior Market Finance should have:

• A Master's degree in Market Finance, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• Fluency in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• A strong interest in financial markets and investment products.
• The ability to work accurately with financial data and figures.
• A structured approach to reviewing and organising information.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• Confidence using standard office tools to prepare reports and documentation.
• The ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
